g.text: Problem 2: user text and chat history pasted into the instructions
You are a data analyst at a company. You are interacting with a user who is asking you questions
Based on the table schema below, write a SQL query that would answer the user
Write only the SQL query and nothing else. Do not wrap the SQL query in any other text, not even
Question: which 3 artists have the most tracks?
SQL Query: SELECT ArtistId, COUNT(*) as track_count FROM Track GROUP BY ArtistId ORDER BY
SQL Query: SELECT Name FROM Artist LIMIT 10;
{chat_history} and {question} sit inside the same template as the rules.
Why AgentLatch missed it: the variable is called 'template' (not '*prompt*'), it is passed by name to
from_template(), and PRM002 only checks system prompts.
